title: Wardrobe, tier Full: 10 heroines x 7 outfits (5 pose candidates A-E + 1 final each)
owner_gate: face of every frame matches the H1 canon; owner approves each outfit from the 3-pose search sheet before its final is paid

budget.hard_stop_rule: nominal + 15%: above that the run stops and the owner is asked
assumptions: search 5 x 1 cr + final 1 x 2 cr = 7 cr per outfit, 70 outfits = 490 cr (round 2: 350 cr with 3 poses; the Standard-tier H2 was 200 cr)

candidates_policy: search: 5 candidates per outfit at 1k medium (1 cr), candidate n uses prompt_variants[n] (five different poses A-E: A-C general, D leg-focus, E bust-focus); final: 1 candidate of the chosen pose at 2k high (2 cr)

selection.gate: Full-tier look gate (design/ART_TIER_FULL.md section 7) + anatomy audit
criteria: boldness at the owner's reference level (stockings with bands, deep neckline, playful pose), not tamer

hard lines: clearly adult face (a young look is a fail) and 6.75-7.0 heads with the crotch line at 45-48% of height, nothing nude (no nipples, no genitals), no explicit act, no school or minor coding, no text
anatomy double audit passed: crops of hands, fingers, legs and feet show no extra or fused limbs
face reads as the canon heroine (>= 4 of 5 traits: eye shape, face width, nose/mouth, apparent age, brows) vs the element portrait
hair colour, signature items and outfit match the canon card; no drift (hair_never rules)
no text, no logos, no watermark, no garbled glyphs anywhere; mahjong tiles blank
outfit matches the wardrobe table text (colour, cut, legwear band); the heroine identity items stay (hair, horns, ears, glasses, headphones, signature accessories)
the three pose candidates are three different poses (not the same pose three times)

pilot.go_rule: 3 outfits x 5 poses: the swim, bunny and robe outfits are the ones most likely to trip the generator moderation; look at them before releasing the rest

tool_note: gpt_image_2_6 + Elements, tail `v5f`. Outfit slots: base, evening, swim, service (bunny / maid / bartender), robe (sleepwear robe-dress), battle (battle / idol), seasonal.
guards: Before each launch: estimate_*_cost -> quote_ref; abort the task when the quote is above max_credits.
Actual spend goes to design/art_batches/SPEND_LOG.csv; more than 15% over the batch nominal = stop and ask the owner.
Every output lands in assets/incoming, then double anatomy audit -> metadata scrub -> watermark pass -> manifest `approve`.
Prompts are untested: run the pilot tasks first (2-3 frames), look at them, only then release the rest.
